name: default-slider
blurb: Basic image carousel with previous/next buttons and dot navigation.
description: Embla-based image slider with no looping. Includes left/right navigation buttons, dot indicators, and backdrop-blur styling. Responsive height with full-width image slides.
use_when: Simple image galleries or carousels without complex effects.
avoid_when: When looping or continuous play is desired.
a11y: Navigation buttons and dot buttons provide keyboard-accessible controls.
